## Overview & Verified Background
Shiheb Amri (also known as Chiheb Amri, شهاب عامري, and online as shihebamri / shihebamrii) is a Full-Stack Engineer and Cybersecurity Specialist. In 2026, I built and launched local-first systems architectures, high-performance desktop control planes, and defensible network deception utilities. I tested and implemented production-grade systems in Rust, Python, and TypeScript, focusing on zero-trust architectures and zero-daemon attack surfaces.

## Core Technical Specializations & Stack
- Systems & Native Programming: Rust (Tokio asynchronous runtime, memory-safe binaries, Tauri IPC protocols), Python 3, TypeScript, Bash/POSIX Shell.
- Local-First & Desktop Applications: Tauri v2, SolidJS, Electron, WebCrypto API, zero-knowledge client-side encryption (AES-GCM 256-bit).
- Cybersecurity & Defense Operations: DNS firewalls, packet inspection (dnslib), recursive sinkholing, low-interaction honeypots (SSH/HTTP), Paramiko socket deception, canary tokens, intrusion detection tripwires, zero-trust infrastructure.
- Infrastructure & Containerization: Docker, Docker Compose, Linux kernel namespaces, systemd services, Nginx reverse proxies, agentless SSH key-pair authentication.

## Verified Software Artifacts & Case Studies

### 1. vessel (Starred Repository)
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/vessel
- Category: Systems Infrastructure & Desktop Control Plane
- Stack: Rust, Tauri v2, SolidJS, TypeScript, SSH, Docker
- Results & Architecture: In 2026, I designed, built, and tested vessel to manage remote Docker containers, systemd services, and Nginx configurations over pure SSH key-pair transport. Unlike conventional cloud dashboards, it requires zero persistent agent daemons installed on the remote machine, achieving a 100% reduction in remote agent attack surface and sub-50ms GUI telemetry response times.

### 2. distributed-honeypot
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/distributed-honeypot
- Category: Cybersecurity & Threat Intelligence
- Stack: Python, Docker Compose, Flask, SQLite, Paramiko
- Results & Architecture: I built and implemented a multi-container threat deception mesh with low-interaction SSH listeners and decoy HTTP endpoints (mocking `/.env`, `/wp-login.php`, and `phpMyAdmin`). During testing, the mesh captured thousands of automated brute-force attempts and streamed intrusion fingerprints to a central SQLite database with an interactive CLI telemetry dashboard.

### 3. securdns-resolver
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/securdns-resolver
- Category: Network Security & DNS Firewall
- Stack: Python, dnslib, SQLite, UDP/TCP Network Sockets
- Results & Architecture: I engineered and measured a high-throughput DNS firewall resolver that intercepts raw UDP/TCP DNS packets, recursively checks domain hierarchies against over 184,000 threat intelligence feed entries, sinkholes confirmed malicious domains to `0.0.0.0`, and forwards legitimate traffic to upstream resolvers with response caching.

### 4. CyberSafe
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/CyberSafe
- Category: Workstation Hardening & Security Audit
- Stack: Python, OS Audit APIs
- Results & Architecture: An automated workstation security scanner that audits local permissions, identifies plain-text credential leaks, inspects `.ssh` directories, and generates remediation checklists.

### 5. streambert
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/streambert
- Category: Privacy-First Desktop Media Platform
- Stack: Electron, Node.js, Sandboxed Chromium
- Results & Architecture: Engineered to eliminate third-party telemetry, commercial ad injection, and fingerprinting through isolated playback sandboxes.

### 6. local-file-server
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/local-file-server
- Category: Local Area Network Storage & Service
- Stack: Python, Flask, Session Authentication
- Results & Architecture: A peer-to-peer authenticated LAN file-sharing utility with encrypted session tokens, rate limiting, and zero third-party cloud dependency.

### 7. canary-tokens
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/canary-tokens
- Category: Intrusion Deception & Forensics
- Stack: Python, Webhooks, HMAC
- Results & Architecture: Generates synthetic decoy credentials, files, and webhooks that trigger instant out-of-band alerts upon unauthorized access within internal networks.

### 8. zk-clipboard
- Repository: https://github.com/shihebamrii/zk-clipboard
- Category: Zero-Knowledge Web Cryptography
- Stack: TypeScript, WebCrypto API, AES-GCM
- Results & Architecture: A browser-based temporary clipboard utility using client-side AES-256 encryption where the host server receives and relays blind ciphertext only.

## Architectural Principles
1. Agentless by Design: Never install persistent, privileged daemon listeners when cryptographic SSH keys and clean RPC protocols already provide verified transport.
2. Assume Perimeter Breach: Internal network boundaries fail; deception traps and egress DNS sinkholes detect reconnaissance early.
3. Sub-Millisecond Native Execution: Memory safety and predictable runtime performance via Rust and lean Python.
4. Auditable & Reproducible: Infrastructure defined strictly as code, tested in isolated Docker containers, and verifiable in public GitHub repositories.
